name: Simple Grave Stones
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.

description: Simple Grave Stones puts your items, armor and XP into a grave when you die. Right-click it to get everything back, with armor going straight into its slots.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers. Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln development build 2026-11-21 (7ae1d6b0) (100 classes, 220 members). Not run yet.
